note_en: The pair 先…再… lays out a sequence, "first … then …": 先带儿子去医院看病，再赶去照顾父母 "first she took her son to the doctor, then rushed off to look after her parents." Unlike English "then," 再 here sits right before the second verb and usually needs an earlier 先 to answer; the text uses the pattern again and again, down to 先照顾好自己的身体，再谈照顾别人 "take care of your own health first, then talk about caring for others."
